Dark voluminous wavy hair surrounds an oval face with high cheekbones, balanced facial thirds, and a rounded hairline showing moderate temporal recession. The features include medium-thick soft-arched eyebrows with lateral tapering, almond-shaped eyes with visible double eyelids, and a straight nasal bridge ending in a rounded tip. The mouth is medium-width with full lips and a defined cupid's bow, and the skin is smooth with no visible marks and no discernible asymmetries.
